title: STEM CELL, GENOME ENG ＆ REGEN MED
description: General lectures on stem cell biology followed by student presentations and discussion of the primary literature. Themes presented include: basic stem cell concepts; basic cell and molecular biological characterization of endogenous stem cell populations; concepts related to reprogramming; directed differentiation of stem cell populations; use of stem cells in disease modeling or tissue replacement/repair; clinical translation of stem cell research.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( BMEN E4001 ) or ( BMEN E4002 ) and Biology, Cell Biology.
